title: Orange moved by psychokinesis in a vivid dream

tellings.quote: suddenly bam, the orange um starts it moves like 8 10 in just like as if something had pushed it.

plain: In a vivid dream set in his family's drawing room, an orange suddenly moved eight to ten inches "as if something had pushed it", says Deep Prasad, a researcher who tells Michels it happened to him. He describes it as psychokinesis, moving an object by the mind alone, and a person he calls Miss Kaur figures in the story. If true, it would suggest the mind can act directly on matter.
